headline: Volkswagen and Dogus Otomotiv Sign Letter of Intent to Evaluate Production in Turkey
summary: Dogus Otomotiv signed a letter of intent with Volkswagen to evaluate options for passenger car production in Turkey.
why: Automotive manufacturing expansions involve substantial capital expenditure and can significantly influence regional industrial output, employment, and supply chain networks.

impacts.name: Volkswagen
impacts.why: Assessing new production facilities impacts long-term capital allocation strategies.
